Name: Ore Berries
Author: ncarigon
Description:
This is mostly just a fun mod to demonstrate making a content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15792/]Bush Bloom Mod[/url].[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15792/]
[/url]
This mod will cause all bushes in the "Mountain" area to occasionally bloom, all year long, with "ore berries" which will drop as copper, iron, gold, iridium, or radioactive ore. This is not balanced, nor is it meant to be, but the higher-tier ores drop significantly less often.

Review this mod's files to see how you can make your own content packs.

Source: [url=https://github.com/ncarigon/StardewValleyMods]ncarigon/StardewValleyMods (github.com)[/url]
